name: hyperlight
description_en: Hyperlight is a lightweight Virtual Machine Manager (VMM) designed to be embedded within applications. It enables safe execution of untrusted code within micro virtual machines with very low latency and minimal overhead.
readme_excerpt: Hyperlight A lightweight VMM for running untrusted code in micro VMs with minimal overhead. A Cloud Native Computing Foundation sandbox project. > Status: Hyperlight is pre-1.0. The API may change between releases, and upgrading will sometimes require code changes. Hyperlight lets you safely run untrusted code inside hypervisor-isolated micro VMs that spin up in milliseconds, with guest function calls completing in microseconds.
